mapper.select: SELECT CAST(to_char(f_today(),'yyyymmdd') as numeric) * 10000000 + CAST(lpad(CAST(nextval('seq') as varchar),7,'0') as numeric)

SELECT fnd01_fund_code_id AS fundCodeId , fnd01_fund_cd AS fundCode , CAST(fnd01_start_date AS date) AS startDate , CAST(fnd01_end_date AS date) AS endDate , fnd01_close_yn AS closeYn , fnd01_plan_yn AS planYn , fnd01_real_fund_id AS realFundId , fnd01_company_id AS companyId , fnd01_icam_yn AS icamYn FROM fnd01_fund_code WHERE fnd01_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd01_fund_cd = #{fundCode}

SELECT fnd02_fund_code_id AS fundCodeId , CAST(fnd02_work_date AS date) AS workDate , fnd02_fund_nm AS fundName , fnd02_fund_full_nm AS fundFullName , fnd02_consignment_cd AS consignmentCode , fnd02_office_work_cd AS officeWorkCode , fnd02_org_code_nm AS orgCodeName , fnd02_kofia_fund_cd AS kofiaFundCode , fnd02_kofia_trust_cd AS kofiaTrustCode , fnd02_kofia_fund_type_cd AS kofiaFundTypeCode , fnd02_kofia_public_cd AS kofiaPublicCode , fnd02_kofia_parent_cd AS kofiaParentCode , fnd02_kofia_class_type_cd AS kofiaClassTypeCode , fnd02_kofia_fund_unit_cd AS kofiaFundUnitCode , fnd02_kofia_char_class_cd AS kofiaCharClassCode , fnd02_end_expect_date AS endExpectDate , fnd02_trust_bank_cd AS trustBankCode , fnd02_operator1 AS operator1 , fnd02_operator2 AS operator2 , fnd02_cur AS cur , fnd02_next_close_date AS nextCloseDate , fnd02_next_fee_date AS nextFeeDate , fnd02_ksd_fund_cd AS ksdFundCode , fnd02_ksd_item_cd AS ksdItemCode , fnd02_management_rate AS managementRate , fnd02_sales_rate AS salesRate , fnd02_consignment_rate AS consignmentRate , fnd02_office_work_rate AS officeWorkRate , fnd02_seolj_aek AS seoljAek , fnd02_sunjasan_aek AS sunjasanAek , fnd02_diff_div_yn AS diffDivYn FROM fnd02_fund_info WHERE fnd02_fund_code_id = #{fundCodeId} AND fnd02_work_date <= #{workDate} ORDER BY fnd02_work_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM fnd02_fund_info WHERE fnd02_work_date = f_trunc(#{p.workDate}) AND fnd02_fund_code_id = #{p.fundCodeId}
